name: Ziapelta
sum: Ziapelta is an ankylosaurid from the Late Campanian Kirtland Formation of New Mexico, with deep, curved squamosal horns.
holotype: NMMNH P-64484, a complete skull without the lower jaws and cervical half-ring parts — De-na-zin Member, Kirtland Formation, New Mexico.
material: A referred specimen NMMNH P-66930 from an older member.
biology: Mostly skulls and anterior bones; no behavioural data.
author: Arbour et al. 2014
